`calibration.mp4` is Playwright's `movie.mp4` browser-test fixture, used only to exercise video decoding, seeking, and marker placement. It is not a volleyball measurement or an accuracy benchmark and is not shipped in the website build.

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/main/tests/assets/movie.mp4
